author: Rainstruck
body:
In an effort to make one of, if not the first 4 team CTW map, I would love some feedback on the current situation I have for this map. So far I have one wool room on this island, and I will copy it to the other four sides so they all have the same spawning area. You spawn in the middle of the tree and you jump down into the water. So Feedback Please!! We would like the second Ravish Brothers Project to be a big success

Album: http://imgur.com/a/KLk17
